messages:
neha: quick RFC follow-up idea: add a tiny 'capability handshake' between runtime and weight-loader so we stop guessing loader features (streamable, atomic-swap, per-chunk decrypt, checksum types).
ryan: yes please. the amount of special-casing for safetensors vs tarball vs sidecar quant is painful.
olga: curious what the handshake looks like. example?
neha: prototype payload (manifest-level hints + live probe): ```
manifest loader_caps: { streaming: true, atomic_swap: false, checksums: ["sha256"], decrypt_modes: ["aes-gcm"] }
CapProbe -> loader: GET /v1/capabilities?bundle_id=sha256:...
loader reply: { streaming: true, atomic_swap: false, max_prefetch: 3, warmup_hint: "low", approx_open_latency_ms: 40 }
```
samir: procedural note: treat manifest hints as "what the bundle supports" and CapProbe reply as "what this worker instance can do right now". runtime policy merges them.
ryan: fallback taxonomy we discussed before: 1) polyfill (conversion to streamable) 2) route to compatible pool 3) degrade behaviour (no streaming) 4) fail fast. add penalty estimates to help Optimize.
olga: add an enforce flag in the manifest (enforce_atomic_swap: true) for critical models so ingestion fails or flags if requirements unmet.
neha: migration: old bundles without loader_caps -> runtime assumes conservative defaults (no streaming, no atomic swap). we'll add a manifest-enricher in ingest to synthesize caps by probing bundles.
samir: security: do not leak key ids. decrypt_modes should be algorithm families only. annotate with policy: "expose_algo_only".
ryan: telemetry: record negotiation_decision event with fields: model, model_version, required_caps, available_caps, fallback_choice, penalty_ms_estimate. feed to Optimize.
neha: action list: write tiny schema RFC for loader_caps, implement CapProbe in loader shim, add manifest-enricher, wire telemetry and rollout gate (start permissive, flip enforce after observing low mismatch_rate).
runtime-bot: created issue ML-1289 and assigned neha/olga/samir (https://go/repo/ML-1289).
olga: i'll draft schema examples for safetensors-sharded, tarball, and quant-sidecar. samir will PoC the CapProbe shim.
neha: perfect. i'll open RFC PR today. thanks all. :rocket:
